ruleDefinitions.name: Veeam Backup Database Suspicious Query
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potentially suspicious SQL queries using SQLCmd targeting the Veeam backup databases in order to steal information.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\sqlcmd\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*VeeamBackup.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*From\\ .*"))) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*BackupRepositories.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Backups.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Credentials.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*HostCreds.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*SmbFileShares.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Ssh\\_creds.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*VSphereInfo.*")))
